mapper.sql: emp55_benefit_info_id AS benefit_info_id, emp55_company_id AS company_id, emp55_benefit_cd AS benefit_code, f_cdnm('EmpBenefitType', emp55_benefit_cd, emp55_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS benefit_name, emp55_issue_link_cd AS issue_link_code, emp55_expense_link_cd AS expense_link_code, emp55_account_cd AS account_code, f_get_account_nm(emp55_company_id, emp55_account_cd) AS account_name, emp55_un_use_yn AS un_use_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp55_benefit_info WHERE emp55_company_id = #{companyId} AND UPPER(CONCAT(emp55_benefit_cd)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp55_benefit_info (emp55_benefit_info_id, emp55_company_id, emp55_benefit_cd, emp55_issue_link_cd, emp55_expense_link_cd, emp55_account_cd, emp55_un_use_yn) VALUES (#{benefitInfoId}, #{companyId}, #{req.benefitCode}, #{req.issueLinkCode}, #{req.expenseLinkCode}, #{req.accountCode}, #{req.unUseYn})

INSERT INTO emp55_benefit_info (emp55_benefit_info_id, emp55_company_id, emp55_benefit_cd, emp55_issue_link_cd, emp55_expense_link_cd, emp55_account_cd, emp55_un_use_yn) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , emp55_benefit_cd , emp55_issue_link_cd , emp55_expense_link_cd , emp55_account_cd , emp55_un_use_yn FROM emp55_benefit_info WHERE emp55_benefit_info_id = #{benefitInfoId}
